name: How can I, as a client, participate in construction quality assurance?

mainEntity.name: How can I, as a client, participate in construction quality assurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: As a client, you can actively participate in construction quality assurance by regularly reviewing project progress, asking questions about procedures, and communicating any observations or concerns to your project manager. Reviewing progress reports, attending site meetings, and understanding key milestones will keep you informed. Preparation involves familiarizing yourself with the project's design documents and specifications so you can effectively monitor alignment with your vision and contractual agreements. This collaborative approach enhances overall project quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clients can participate in quality assurance by reviewing progress, asking questions, and communicating concerns with the project manager.
